items.t: Wipers can quit working (recall)
items.job: Clean or replace wiper motor circuit breaker
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Fuel tank can crack from evaporative system fault (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel tank and filler cap
items.note: The recall tests the tank and replaces it if cracked. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Front subframe rusts through in salt states (recall)
items.note: The recall inspects and replaces rusted subframes free. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Side airbag warning light and side airbags may not deploy (recall)
items.job: Secure side airbag wiring and connectors
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Engine can stall from mass airflow sensor wiring (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Fuel tank valve may not close (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Brake light switch faults (recalls)
items.note: Often free under Hyundai's brake light switch recalls. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Passenger airbag may switch off for small adults (recall)
items.job: Recalibrate or replace passenger seat occupant sensor
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Rear crossmember rust can let a control arm break loose (recall)
items.note: The recall repairs or replaces the crossmember free. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Water in ABS module can short and overheat (recall)
items.job: Install ABS power relay per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. If the ABS module itself failed, expect much more.

items.t: Stability control may brake a wheel on its own (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Throttle sensor codes and cold idle surge
items.note: Cleaning the throttle body or a software update sometimes fixes it first.

items.t: Theta II engine knocking and seizure
items.note: Often covered by recall or lifetime engine warranty if the knock-sensor update was done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Excessive oil consumption
items.note: Dealers run an oil use test first. Ask whether Hyundai's Theta II engine coverage applies to your VIN.

items.t: Fuel leak in the engine bay, often after engine replacement (recalls)
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pipe or fuel hose
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Airbags may not deploy in a crash (recall)
items.job: Install airbag control unit wire filter kit
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Front seat belt can come loose from its anchor (recalls)
items.job: Inspect and repair seat belt anchor linkage
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Shift cable can detach and car may roll away (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: 6-speed automatic harsh shifts or slipping
items.note: A software update and fluid change sometimes fix it. If the transmission must be replaced, expect much more.

items.t: Loss of power steering assist or steering shaft faults (recalls)
items.job: Replace power steering control unit or shaft joint
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Front coil spring can break
items.note: Price is per side. 2011 cars are covered by a recall; check your VIN.

items.t: Brake fluid leak at brake line fittings (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Hybrid ABS unit can short and catch fire (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Park outside until done. If the ABS module is damaged, expect much more.

items.t: Theft risk on key-start models without immobilizer
items.note: The anti-theft software update is free at Hyundai dealers. Price is for fixing an ignition damaged in a theft attempt.

items.t: Front brake caliper can crack (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Left front axle shaft may separate (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Sunroof panel can come loose (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Parking brake warning light may not come on (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Turn signal may flash the wrong direction (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Trunk cannot be opened from inside (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Remote parking assist may not stop the car (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Trunk may not open from inside (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Fuel tank can melt near the exhaust (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel tank check valve and update software
items.note: Free under the recall. The fuel tank is replaced too if it is damaged.

items.t: High-pressure fuel pump pipe leak (recall)
items.job: Tighten or replace high-pressure fuel pipe
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Transmission oil pump fault can cause loss of drive (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Many cars only need the inspection and software update.

items.t: Electric oil pump controller can overheat (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Park outside until it is done.

items.t: Brake lights may flash or not light properly (recall)
items.note: Free over-the-air or dealer update. Check your VIN.

items.t: Instrument display can go blank (recall)
items.note: Free over-the-air or dealer update. Check your VIN.

items.t: Side airbags can go off without a crash (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 02V-145. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Chrome inside door handles can turn sharp (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 09V-171. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Driver airbag may not inflate fully (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 16V-232. Check the VIN first.

items.t: ABS warning light may stay off during a fault (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 15V-678. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Windshield may not be bonded properly (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 21V-00M. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Low-pressure fuel hose can crack and leak
items.note: Free under recall 22V-312. Check the VIN first.
